notes: QR-first pairing: scan the web QR once — relay URL and token live in private storage, no manual entry, no test button. Sticky two-way presence: the app heartbeats while open (roster shows your phone), the web beacon tells the phone the viewer is watching, and live sessions verify the link with a real ping/pong round-trip. Unpair by long-pressing the paired name; re-pair with a fresh QR.
